prescriptionGlasses.name: Zips ZP4140
prescriptionGlasses.description:
A stylish and easy-to-wear frame created for smaller faces and teen-friendly comfort. With its balanced 51–19–145 fit, fresh crystal colour options, and refined details like metal pin accents and a self-locking screw, this model offers a modern look that feels practical, polished, and comfortable for everyday wear.

Recommended age group: 16+ years / adults.
This size usually fits a small to medium adult face.

products.name: Carrera 302S3
products.description:
Carrera 302/S is a bold, modern men’s sunglass with clear Carrera DNA. It has a strong rectangular / pilot-inspired front, a double bridge, and slim temples with metal detailing, so it gives a sporty premium look without feeling too heavy. Official Carrera product pages describe it as a men’s style built to stand out, and it is also RX-able, so it can be fitted with prescription sun lenses.

Specifications

Model: Carrera 302/S

Approx. frame width: 143 mm (calculated total width)

Lens width: 59 mm

Lens height: 47.8 mm (some sellers round this to 48 mm)

Bridge width: 15 mm

Temple length: 145 mm

Weight: about 32 g for at least one listed variant; this can vary slightly by color/lens combination.

Frame material: Polyamide injected / plastic

Lens material: Polycarbonate

Lens specification: depending on variant, available with polarized or gradient lenses; 100% UV protection; filter category 3 on the polarized official variant; prescription-compatible.

Suitable gender: officially marketed mainly for men, but the shape can also work as unisex for people who like a bold oversized fit.

Recommended age group: adults / 18+. Because of the 59 mm lens width and approx. 143 mm frame width, it suits medium to large adult faces best

Style summary
This model is best for someone who wants a confident, masculine, premium everyday sunglass with Carrera’s signature racing-inspired attitude. The wide 59 mm eye size and double bridge make it especially good for medium-large faces and for people who want stronger face presence. This fit assessment is an inference from the published dimensions.

products.name: Elton
products.description:
Refined, modern, and effortlessly wearable, these FocusRobin acetate sunglasses bring a clean round silhouette with a bold black finish that suits both everyday styling and elevated looks. The smooth full-rim acetate frame offers a premium feel while keeping the design lightweight and comfortable for regular use. The soft round shape gives the pair a timeless character, making it easy to match with casual, streetwear, or smart outfits.

Designed for both style and protection, these sunglasses feature polarized lenses that help reduce glare and improve visual comfort in bright conditions. The lenses also provide UV400 100% protection, helping shield your eyes from harmful UVA and UVB rays. With an anti-scratch coating, 1.1 mm lens thickness, and CAT3 protection level, this pair is a reliable choice for sunny days, driving, travel, and daily outdoor wear.
